rows.en: I-If you get cold, please tell me, okay?
rows.notes: Male, frd_myk_114. Miyuki hinting she would lend her jacket (cf. the female version c11418).

rows.en: Yeah, I'm fine.
Geez... You're so dense...
rows.notes: Male; Miyuki mutters at the player (donkan).

rows.en: (I came to Folmo with Miyuki again today~)

When we come to Folmo, there's only one place
to hit first, right~!
...Soft serve, right!

Is it really okay to eat so much soft serve
that you're stuffed?
My stomach's the one part of me that's tough!

If you get cold, please tell me, okay?
I'll lend you my jacket.
Okay, I'll be counting on you if I do.
(Today I came swimming with Shirakawa.)

Nah, girls need time to get ready.
It can't be helped.
rows.notes: Male; answers Miyuki's 'Sorry to keep you waiting'.

rows.en: Th-Then, shall we go swimming?
Phew, let's rest a bit...
Here, have a drink.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki hands the player a drink.

rows.en:
Thanks. Coming here always gets me
all hyped up.
The ocean really is fun, isn't it?

Oh, but don't get so hyped up
that something terrible happens, okay?
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders. taihen na koto kept vague; Miyuki's embarrassed reaction suggests a swimsuit mishap is implied.

rows.en: Hmph! I don't care!!
(Today I came swimming with Miyuki~)
Yep, I'm all set over here!
rows.notes: Female; answers 'Sorry to keep you waiting'.

rows.en: Well then, let's go swimming.

Thanks. This place always gets you
all hyped up, right?
Yes, the ocean really is fun...
(I came swimming with Shirakawa again today.)
Yeah, I've got the parasol and stuff all set up.
rows.notes: Male; answers 'Sorry to keep you waiting'.

rows.en: Well then, shall we go swimming?
Phew, time for a little break...
I'm glad you're having fun, Shirakawa.
...I like the ocean, after all.
B-Besides...
Besides?
I-It's nothing!
I-I'm... going for a swim!!
(I came swimming with Miyuki again today~)
I've got the parasol and our stuff all set up.
I'm relieved you're having fun, Miyuki.

(Today I was supposed to go see a movie
with Shirakawa.)
rows.notes: x2, male, frd_myk_116 (both sub-scenes; in one the player is late).

rows.en:
\p-kun,
you're late... I thought you weren't coming...

S-Sorry.
I hurried, but I ended up a little late...
...It's fine. You came, after all.
Sh-Shirakawa...
That was a lovely movie, wasn't it?

That romance was so sweet it gave me heartburn.
Do you dream of a love like that too, Shirakawa?
M-M-M-Me? N-N-N-N-N-Not particularly!!!
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki; stutter kept (watashi wa betsu ni).

rows.en:
It was a good movie! That's all!!
N-Now then, let's go get f-f-food!!!
rows.notes: Male; the stutter is on gohan.

rows.en:
(Today I was supposed to go see a movie
with Miyuki.)

\p-san,
you're late... I thought you weren't coming...

S-Sorry!
I hurried, but I ended up a little late...
Miyuki...

That romance just melted my heart.
Do you dream of a love like that too, Miyuki?

...Now, about that panic.
Care to tell me all about it...?
I-It's nothing, really!
rows.notes: Female; Miyuki drops into casual speech here (nan demo nai kara).

rows.en: Let's go get something to eat~!
(...Today was a nice change of pace~)

We showed up at the same time today.
Maybe we've got good chemistry, huh?
rows.notes: Male; Miyuki greeted him with '\p-san, hello' (c02229).

rows.en: Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What are you SAYING?!
The only joke allowed here is your face!!
rows.notes: Male (joudan wa kao dake ni shite kudasai), insult kept.

rows.en: O-Only my face? That's harsh...
Geez! We're going!!

That movie was nothing but macho guys...
Do you like muscle-bound guys like that too,
Shirakawa?
Huh? N-No, I-I'm... w-well...

...It's a secret!
N-Now then, let's go get f-f-food!!!

We showed up at the same time today.
Maybe we've got good chemistry?

Hehehe, you're right. We're such good friends,
after all.
Then let's head to the theater!

That movie was nothing but macho guys...
Do you like muscle-bound guys like that, Miyuki?

Huh? N-No, I-I'd rather go for
someone more slender...

Got it, so you'd take a skinny beansprout
over a big lump of meat.

I didn't say beansprout~!
Geez! Let's just go eat, okay!?
